
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/20008424" title="发布于 2026-05-10 22:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】使用自定义的值比较器</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>EF Core 默认实现了许多值比较器，用于在实体状态追踪时检查属性值是否被修改。故大多情况下，咱们不需要操作心。但，凡是总有特殊情况，有些数据虽然值不相等，但所表示的意思是相等的。这种时候就不能依靠默认的比较器了。</p>
<p>老周举一个连外星人都知道的例子。假设有这样的实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Company
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Guid CompID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Phone { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个类表示某些公司信息，除主键外，两个属性分别表示公司名称和固话。银河系居民都了解，固话由区号和电话号码组成，且有两种写法：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">010</span>)<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">88988989</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">010</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">88988989</span></pre>
</div>
<p>也就是说，用户给 Phone 属性设置这两个值，指的是同一个固话。若以默认的字符串比较器，肯定会认为二者不相等的。所以，这就要咱们动手了。</p>
<p>要实现自定义的比较器，99% 的做法是从&nbsp;ValueComparer&lt;T&gt; 类派生。不需要重写任何成员，只提供三个方法（由对应的委托类型接收）的实现，然后传给基类的构造函数即可。</p>
<p>需要的三个委托为：</p>
<p>1、<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Func&lt;T, T, bool&gt;</span>：两个输入参数是 T 的值，返回值是 bool 类型。该委托用于判断两个值是否相等，相等就返回 true，不相等就返回 false。</p>
<p>2、<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Func&lt;T, int&gt;</span>：返回输入参数 T 的哈希值，整型。</p>
<p>3、<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Func&lt;T, T&gt;</span>：此委托用于创建“快照”，由 ChangeTracker 负责管理。返回的 T 实例就是创建的快照实例。对于简单类型，咱们不需要实现这个委托。它主要面向需要深度拷贝或存在嵌套数据的值，用于自定义属性值的拷贝。</p>
<p>对于这个固定电话，咱们要实现相等比较和哈希计算，创建快照不需要实现，使用 EF Core 内置的就可以。</p>
<p>于是，定义&nbsp;MyValueComparer 类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyValueComparer : ValueComparer&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配规则
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> REGEX_PATTERN = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">^\\(?(\\d{3,4})(?:\\)|-)?(\\d{6,})$</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> 辅助方法
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 分析固话号码
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="no"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">输入值</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">返回区号和电话</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> phone) ParsePhoneNo(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> no)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 分析号码</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> res =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Regex.Match(no, REGEX_PATTERN);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实际捕捉两个分组</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(res.Success)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
                    res.Groups[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value,
                    res.Groups[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value
                );
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Empty, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 两个固话号码是否相等
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsEqual(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? val1, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val2)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (val1 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; val2 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (val1 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; val2 != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (val1 != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; val2 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code1, phone1;       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一个号码</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code2, phone2;       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二个号码</span>
        (code1, phone1) =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> ParsePhoneNo(val1)</span>;
        (code2, phone2) </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> ParsePhoneNo(val2)</span>;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 两个号码的区号与电话是否相同</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (code1 == code2 &amp;&amp; phone1 ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> phone2);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算哈希值
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> GetHash(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> val)
    {
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ph) =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ParsePhoneNo(val);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HashCode.Combine(code, ph);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyValueComparer()
           :</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>((p1, p2) =&gt; IsEqual(p1, p2),  p =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetHash(p))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> .........</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>上面代码中，老周使用正则表达式来提取固话中的区号的号码。先解释一下这个匹配规则。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>^\\(?(\\d{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>})(?:\\)|-)?(\\d{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>,})$</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>^ 表示开头字符；</li>
<li>\(? 表示开头的字符可能是左括号，但可能不出现，所以用 ? 匹配；</li>
<li>(\d{3,4}) 这是一个分组，匹配时会把它存储起来，\d 是数字，{3，4} 表示数字的出现次数为最少三次最多四次。即区号由三到四个数字组成；</li>
<li>(?:\)|-)? 表示可选的右括号或者“-”。(?: ...) 避免被识别为分组，因为我们对右括号和“-”不感兴趣，匹配结果也不要存储这些字符，所以用 ?: 告诉正则处理引擎可以匹配它，但不要存到结果中，我们不需要；“|”表示分支（并列、或），即可以出现右括号或“-”。后面的 ? 表示这个分组可以出现可以不出现。其实这里用“+”也可以，右括号和“-”应该至少出现一次；</li>
<li>&nbsp;(\d{6,})$ “$”表示字符串结尾，号码部分同样也是匹配数字，{6, } 表示至少出现六次。也可以是 {6,8}，不过这里老周就没把规则定那么严格。</li>
</ul>
<p>正则匹配成功后，应从 Groups 集合中找结果，不要去&nbsp;Captures 中找。Groups 集合存储了两个分组中匹配的数字字符（区号和号码）。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(res.Success)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
            res.Groups[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value,
            res.Groups[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value
        );
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Groups 集合中，第一个元素存的是整个字符串，所以要从第二个元素获取分组的文本（索引1起）。</p>
<p>好了，现在咱们实现数据库上下文类，并在配置数据库模型时应用自定义的比较器。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;Company&gt; Companies { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(</span><em><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">server=.\\Test;database=some_db;Trust Server Certificate=True;Integrated Security=True</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></em><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Company&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.CompID).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmp_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmp_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">45</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Phone).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmp_phone</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">.Metadata.SetValueComparer(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">new</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> MyValueComparer());</span></strong>
            ent.HasKey(x </span>=&gt; x.CompID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Company</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>要注意的是，PropertyBuilder 的成员方法/扩展方法并没有让咱们设置比较器的（使用 HasConversion 方法除外，配置值转换器时可以设置比较器。但这种只适合你需要转换类型的情形）。不过没事，咱们可以通过元数据对象来设置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>.Metadata.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">SetValueComparer</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> MyValueComparer())</pre>
</div>
<p>访问 PropertyBuilder.Metadata 得到的是属性元数据。要是访问 EntityTypeBuilder 的 Metadata 呢，那就是实体类型元数据。</p>
<p>下面，创建数据库上下文实例，先动态创建数据库，然后我们修改第一条记录的 Phone 属性为【与原电话号码相同但格式不同的电话】。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> c = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> created =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c.Database.EnsureCreated();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(created)
    {
        c.Companies.AddRange([
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Company
            {
                Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">三鬼贸易有限公司</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Phone </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">020-55128130</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Company
            {
                Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">一口焖信息服务有限公司</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Phone </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">0765-20881919</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            }
            ]);
        c.SaveChanges();
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> c = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> obj =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c.Companies.FirstOrDefault();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(obj != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        obj.Phone </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">(020)55128130</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        c.<em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ChangeTracker.DetectChanges</span></em>();    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测是否更改
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印跟踪信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        Console.WriteLine(c.ChangeTracker.ToDebugString(ChangeTrackerDebugStringOptions.IncludeProperties));
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在插入数据时，咱们设置的值是&nbsp;020-55128130，之后我们修改为&nbsp;(020)55128130，咱们认为这是同一个号码。由于这里老周没有调用 SaveChanges 方法，即不会保存到数据库。所以，需要调用一次&nbsp;ChangeTracker.DetectChanges 方法，强制 context 做一轮更改扫描。最后向控制台打印跟踪信息。</p>
<p>属性修改后，跟踪信息如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Company {CompID: 286554a7-e1f4-4ab1-e791-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">08deae71e616} <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 204, 255, 1)">Unchanged</span></strong>
    CompID: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">286554a7-e1f4-4ab1-e791-08deae71e616</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PK
    Name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">三鬼贸易有限公司</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Phone: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">(020)55128130</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> Originally <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">020-55128130</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<p>抠亮眼睛看清楚呢，属性值确实是变了的，但由于咱们自定义的比较器在作怪，所以，实体的状态依然被标记为 Unchanged。</p>
<p>&nbsp;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>接下来，咱们看看值转器和值比较器一起用的情况。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表示颜色的结构</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBColor
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> Red { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> Green { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> Blue { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造函数</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> RGBColor(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> r, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> g, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b)
    {
        Red </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r;
        Green </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> g;
        Blue </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b;
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 纸张 - 实体类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Paper
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> WidthCM { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> HeightCM { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">RGBColor</span></strong> Color { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Paper 实体类的 Color 属性是 RGBColor 结构类型，而存入数据库时，我们只需要一个 uint 值即可，因此，它需要一个值转换器。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> RGBValueConverter : ValueConverter&lt;RGBColor, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> 封装方法
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> RGBColor IntToColor(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> color)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> red = Convert.ToByte((color &gt;&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span>) &amp; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xff</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> green = Convert.ToByte((color &gt;&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>) &amp; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xff</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span> blue = Convert.ToByte(color &amp; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xff</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">new</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> RGBColor(red, green, blue)</span></strong>;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> ColorToInt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBColor color)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Convert.ToUInt32(<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">(color.Red &lt;&lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span>) | (color.Green &lt;&lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>) |</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> color.Blue</span></strong>);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造函数</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBValueConverter()
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>(rgb =&gt; ColorToInt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> rgb), cv =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IntToColor(cv))
    { }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>由于 uint 是 32 位整数，咱们用它的低 24 位就可以表示 RGB 值。在查询数据时，数据库提供程序先以 uint 类型读出值，然后转为 RGBColor 结构实例，再赋给 Paper.Color 属性；反过来，存入数据时，将 RGBColor 的三个属性合成一个 uint 值，再用此值写入数据库。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>由于 Paper 实体类的 Color 属性用的 RGBColor 类型，所以，比较器应面向 RGBColor 结构。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> RGBValueComparer : ValueComparer&lt;RGBColor&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> 封装的方法
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相等比较</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ColorEqual(RGBColor c1, RGBColor c2)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> c1.Red == c2.Red &amp;&amp; c1.Green == c2.Green &amp;&amp; c1.Blue ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c2.Blue;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取哈希值</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ColorHash(RGBColor c)
    {
        HashCode hc </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        hc.Add(c.Red);
        hc.Add(c.Green);
        hc.Add(c.Blue);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hc.ToHashCode();
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建快照</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBColor CreateSnapshot(RGBColor c)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBColor(c.Red, c.Green, c.Blue);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造函数</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RGBValueComparer()
        :</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>((c1, c2) =&gt; ColorEqual(c1, c2), c =&gt; ColorHash(c), c =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CreateSnapshot(c))
    { }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在用于创建快照的&nbsp;CreateSnapshot 方法中，上述代码创了个 RGBColor 实例，并将原 RGBColor 对象的三个属性值作为参数传给构造函数。这就完成了深度拷贝。当然，因为 RGBColor 是值类型，其实它的实例本身就会把成员复制的。这里老周只演示功能，如果换成是类（引用），那就可以拷贝成员了，而不是仅传递引用。</p>
<p>在&nbsp;ColorEqual 方法中，上述代码直接用比较两个 RGBColor 的实例的属性值。只有三个属性值都相等才行。</p>
<p>下面，咱们创建数据库上下文类，并做好配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置连接字符串</span>
        SqlConnectionStringBuilder cnnsbd = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        cnnsbd.DataSource </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(localdb)\\MSSQLLocalDB</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        cnnsbd.InitialCatalog </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        cnnsbd.IntegratedSecurity </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(cnnsbd.ConnectionString);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Paper&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            ent.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_papers</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.ID).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.WidthCM).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wid_cm</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.HeightCM).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hei_cm</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(a </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a.Color)
                 .HasColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p_color</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 应用转换器</span>
                 .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasConversion(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RGBValueConverter(), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> RGBValueComparer())</span></strong>;
            ent.HasKey(s </span>=&gt; s.ID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Papers</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据集合</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;Paper&gt; Papers { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在配置 Color 属性时，通过&nbsp;HasConversion 方法可以指定值转换器和值比较器。</p>
<p>创建数据库上下文实例，插入一条测试数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建数据库</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> r =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctx.Database.EnsureCreated();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(r)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 插入测试数据</span>
        ctx.Papers.Add(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>() { HeightCM = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">219</span>, WidthCM = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>, Color = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RGBColor(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x2f</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x05</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x66</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) });
        ctx.SaveChanges();
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>把刚存入数据库的记录查询出来，然后咱们替换 Color 属性的值，再扫描一遍实体状态。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext())
{
    Paper</span>? p =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Papers.FirstOrDefault();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修改颜色</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        RGBColor c </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.Color;
        c.Blue </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x4e</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        p.Color </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强制扫描更改</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        context.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ChangeTracker.DetectChanges</span></strong>();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印跟踪信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        Console.WriteLine(context.ChangeTracker.DebugView.LongView);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>和上一个示例一样，由于老周没有调用 SaveChanges 方法，所以不会保存到数据库，也不会扫描实体是否更改。需要手动调用一次 DetectChanges 方法强制进行一次扫描，最后打印实体跟踪信息。</p>
<p>输出结果如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Paper {ID: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">Modified</span></strong>
    ID: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PK
    Color: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QixenLie.RGBColor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> Modified Originally <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QixenLie.RGBColor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    HeightCM: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">219</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    WidthCM: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span></pre>
</div>
<p>注意看，实体被标记为 Modified，表明通过值比较器已发现 Color 属性被更改。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>好了，今天的水文就水到这里了。</p>
